**Observation Log:**

[TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/25 (Thu) 14:42  
[USER] User asked for high-level functionalities of an app like Pinterest.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] High-level functionalities of an app like Pinterest include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Image/Content Discovery: Users can search and discover new images and ideas related to their interests.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Image Sharing: Users can share and upload their own images and categorize them into boards.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Board Creation: Users can create boards to organize and categorize their saved images and ideas.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Follow/Unfollow: Users can follow other users, boards, and topics to see their content in their feed.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Repinning: Users can save and share other users' images to their own boards.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Image Commenting: Users can add comments to images and start conversations with other users.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Image Tagging: Users can tag other users and products in images.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 8. Personalization: Users can personalize their feed, boards, and profile to match their interests.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 9. Image Recommendations: The app can provide image recommendations based on users' past interactions and behavior.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 10. Notifications: Users can receive notifications for new images, comments, and followers.  
[USER] User requested low-level functionalities of "Image/Content Discovery."  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Low-level functionalities for "Image/Content Discovery" include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Keyword search: Users can search for images using keywords related to their interests.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Hashtag search: Users can search for images using hashtags.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Categories: Users can browse images by categories such as fashion, food, travel, etc.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Trending: Users can see trending images and topics.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Related images: Users can see images related to their current search.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Filtering: Users can filter their search results by date, popularity, etc.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Infinite Scrolling: Users can continuously scroll to see more images.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 8. Lightbox view: Users can view images in a lightbox mode,
